name: @ip-guard/desktop
description: Windows application IPv4 launch gate and network guardian

scripts.build: node scripts/build-assets.ts && node scripts/build-native.ts && vp build --config vite.main.config.ts && vp build --config vite.preload.config.ts
scripts.package: vp run --filter @ip-guard/browser-extension build && vp run --filter @ip-guard/web build && node scripts/copy-renderer.ts && vp run build && node scripts/package.ts
